EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 954 May 4, 1984
CREATING THE POSITION OF EXECUTIVE VICE PRESIDENT IN THE POLYTECHNIC
UNIVERSITY OF THE PHILIPPINES
WHEREAS, there is a need to further strengthen the organizational structure of the Polytechnic University of
the Philippines to make it more responsive to the present requirements of the University;
WHEREAS, under Presidential Decree No. 1416, the President of the Philippines has continuing authority to
reorganize the administrative structure of the National Government to promote efficiency in the government.
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by the Constitution, do hereby create, in addition to the existing officers in the Polytechnic
University of the Philippines, the position of Executive Vice President.
This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 4th day of May, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty-four.
